title: What If the Moon Vanished Tonight?
summary: The Moon does more than light up the night. Here is what would change on Earth if it suddenly disappeared.

beats.text: Tonight you look up, and the Moon is simply gone. What happens next?
First, nights get darker. Without moonlight, only stars and city lights remain.
Quick guess. What would change in the oceans?
beats.reveal: The tides! Most of their pull comes from the Moon, so they would shrink a lot.

beats.text: The Sun would still pull on the water, so tides stay, but they get weaker.
Here is the slow chain of changes over a very long time.
The Moon also helps keep Earth's tilt steady. Without it, the tilt could wander over millions of years.
Days would also stay a little shorter, because the Moon slowly drags on Earth's spin.
So you would not notice much tomorrow, but the planet would change slowly and deeply.
One more thing about our neighbour.

visual.text: The Moon is slowly drifting away from Earth, by about a few centimetres every year.
